submitted.rationale: Among five EQE measurements across the Fe-Sb-O line, index 4 (Sb 0.21) gave the highest EQE (0.0190%). Neighbours gave 0.0168% at Sb 0.12 and 0.0113% at Sb 0.27. Values keep falling at higher Sb: 0.0099% at 0.52 and 0.0042% at 0.75. This suggests an Fe-rich optimum near Sb ~0.2, where the Fe2O3-like phase absorbs the 2.1 eV light.
